data.description:
Welcome to a world of wellness. Build healthy habits with yoga, Pilates, and mindfulness classes in your own luxury virtual studio. Start now with a 7-day free trial.

📆 NEW CLASSES ADDED EVERY MONTH
🧘 Hit your strength and flexibility goals with Yoga & Pilates for all levels.
✨ Calm your mind and get better sleep with Meditations and Sound Baths in 360° surround sound.
🌎 Practice in epic environments around the world, from the beaches of Spain to the fjords of Norway.
💪 Enjoy a fully immersive private studio. Walk around your 3D trainers and look at your mini instructors to see each move from all angles.
⏱ Busy schedule? Classes range from 5-30 minutes.
🏆 Unlock achievements and stay on track with weekly and monthly class streaks.

Slip on the headset, step into class, and see your strongest self come to life. Start your free 7-day trial now.

changelog.change_log:
What’s New

Connection Test - Alo Moves now performs a connection test to the servers to ensure users have an uninterrupted streaming experience. If the connection is determined to be slow, the app will switch to download mode, allowing users to download classes for the best experience.

Download Classes - Downloading classes enables users to enjoy the same great experience even with a lower bandwidth connection.

Improved stability - Fixed various bugs for a more immersive experience.

What’s New
1. Meet New Instructor Josh Kramer — We're excited to introduce a new instructor to Alo Moves XR! Meet Josh Kramer, an international yoga teacher who travels around the world leading classes, workshops, and retreats. His style blends Iyengar yoga and Vinyasa flow, which leads to strong and creative sequencing with a focus on alignment.

2. Introducing Series — guided programs designed to help you achieve your workout goals, whether it's getting stronger, working on your flexibility, or creating a daily movement habit.

Explore our three new series:
- Yoga Strong — Challenge yourself with yoga-inspired workouts to sharpen your fitness, flexibility, and mental fortitude featuring new instructor Josh Kramer.
- Short & Sweet — Take a wellness break on busy days with Pilates, yoga, meditations, and sound baths that are all 10 minutes or less.
- The Pilates Collection — Meet the essential bodyweight Pilates workouts for strength, flexibility, and core sculpting from Bianca Wise.

What’s New

- We fixed a passthrough bug that was causing everything to disappear after taking off and putting back on the headset.

- Hands now adjust opacity during class to make your sessions more immersive and less distracting.

- Instructor bios are now expandable to let you dive deeper into their stories.

What's New

*We're always looking for ways to make your experience with Alo Moves XR even better. Check out the recent changes we made on the app.

*Improved stability - Enjoy smoother, more reliable performance so you can focus on class without interruptions.

*Video recording fix - Want to see a playback of your class? Now you can record your sessions from the Quest headset.

*New mindfulness classes - Explore a fresh set of calming meditations to energize your morning or relax before bed.
